# Malhar Baug Resort Alibaug

> Official guest guide and resort information for Malhar Baug Resort — a 3-star farm-style family resort in Nagaon (Palhe), Alibaug, Maharashtra, located 2 km from Nagaon Beach.

## Quick Facts
- **Property Name**: Malhar Baug Resort
- **Google Star Rating**: 3-Star Resort (4.2/5 based on 46 Google Reviews)
- **Nightly Price Range**: ₹4,229 to ₹6,500 per night (direct booking rate)
- **Check-In / Check-Out**: Check-in: 12:00 PM | Check-out: 10:00 AM
- **Address**: H.No. 3116, Nagaon, Palhe, Raigad, Maharashtra 402204, India
- **Coordinates**: 18.6019° N, 72.9056° E
- **Nearby Beaches**: Nagaon Beach (2 km - 3.7 km), Akshi Beach (5.7 km), Revdanda Beach (8.2 km), Kihim Beach (16 km), Alibaug Beach & Kolaba Fort (9 km)
- **Direct Phone**: +91 90351 98520
- **WhatsApp**: +91 99875 52273 / +91 91520 18635
- **Official Booking Engine**: Hotel ID 2970 on TheHotelMate / BookOne
- **Official Website**: https://www.malharbaugresort.com

## Key Amenities & Features
- **Swimming Pool**: Clean, hygienic open-air swimming pool with shallow area for children, garden loungers, and 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM daily hours.
- **Accommodations**: Super Deluxe AC Rooms (king bed, attached bath, balcony), 2-Bedroom Hall Family Villa, and 4-Bedroom Hall Private Villa for groups of 8–15 guests.
- **Dining**: Home-style authentic Konkani & Maharashtrian cuisine, fresh surmai/pomfret fish thali, chicken sukka, vegetarian thali, breakfast, and garden barbecue.
- **Lawn & Events**: Expansive outdoor party lawn for intimate weddings, birthday celebrations, corporate offsites, and team-building outings.
- **Guest Facilities**: Free high-speed Wi-Fi, 100% power backup, complimentary private parking, kids play area, indoor games (carrom, chess), bonfire setups.
